description: Meta-Optimizer Page — The central dashboard for the prompt optimization pipeline. Contains 14 sub-tabs covering progress tracking, recommendations, prompt optimization via beam search + dueling bandits, canary A/B testing, eval specs, and adaptive learning. The three new tabs (Duel Pools, Beam Runs, Span Events) display data from the agent-lightning + prompt-ops integration: beam search candidate generation, pairwise duel evaluation with Copeland ranking, and granular span-level execution instrumentation.

groups.name: Page Layout & Structure
groups.description: The MetaOptimizerPage renders a horizontal tab bar at the top and a scrollable content area below. The tab bar contains 14 tabs. The page fills the full height of its container.

assertions.description: A horizontal tab bar is present at the top of the page containing all sub-tab buttons

target.label: First tab button in tab bar

assertions.description: The tab bar contains exactly 14 tab buttons: Progress, Recommendations, Prompt Optimization, Prompt Registry, Config Suggestions, Run History, Eval Specs, Robustness, Duel Pools, Beam Runs, Span Events, Adaptive Learning, Playbook, Prompt Evolution
On initial load, the Progress tab is selected (active styling: bg-zinc-800, text-zinc-100, border-zinc-700) and its content is visible

groups.name: Tab Navigation
groups.description: Clicking any tab button switches the visible content panel. Only one tab's content is rendered at a time.

assertions.description: Clicking the 'Duel Pools' tab button switches to the DuelPoolsTab content panel, showing the header 'Duel Pools' and hiding the previous tab's content
Clicking the 'Beam Runs' tab button switches to the BeamRunsTab content panel, showing the header 'Beam Search Runs'
Clicking the 'Span Events' tab button switches to the SpanEventsTab content panel, showing the header 'Span Events' and filter inputs
The currently active tab has distinct styling (bg-zinc-800 background, text-zinc-100 text, border with no bottom border) while inactive tabs show text-zinc-400 with hover states

groups.name: Duel Pools — Layout & Empty State
groups.description: The DuelPoolsTab has a two-panel layout: a fixed-width (w-80) pool list sidebar on the left and a flexible detail panel on the right. On initial load it fetches pools from GET /meta-optimizer/duel-pools.

assertions.description: The Duel Pools tab displays a header with text 'Duel Pools', a 'Refresh' button, and a pool count indicator showing 'N pools'
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected

assertions.description: When no duel pools exist, displays: 'No duel pools yet. Duel pools are created by the optimization pipeline during prompt evolution.'
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected and no pools exist in the database

assertions.description: While fetching pools, the tab shows 'Loading...' text
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected and API request is in flight

groups.name: Duel Pools — Pool List & Detail
groups.description: When pools exist, the sidebar lists them with status badges, agent type, generation, and timestamps. Clicking a pool loads its candidates in the detail panel with a Copeland ranking table.

assertions.description: Each pool item in the sidebar shows: a status badge (color-coded: active=green, complete=blue, converged=cyan, failed=red), the agent_type, generation number, truncated pool ID (8 chars), and creation date
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected and at least one pool exists

assertions.description: Clicking a pool in the sidebar fetches pool detail from GET /meta-optimizer/duel-pools/:id and displays a candidates table with columns: #, ID, Status, Copeland, Alpha, Beta, Win Rate, Gen, Variant. Candidates are ranked by Copeland score descending.
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected and pools exist

assertions.description: Clicking a candidate row in the table expands it to reveal the full prompt_content in a pre-formatted code block (bg-zinc-900/50, max-h-48, whitespace-pre-wrap). Clicking again collapses it.
assertions.precondition: A pool is selected and candidates are displayed

groups.name: Duel Pools — Duel Results
groups.description: The duel results section shows pairwise comparison outcomes. Loaded on demand via a 'Show Duel Results' button.

assertions.description: A 'Show Duel Results' button is present below the candidates table. After clicking, it changes text to 'Refresh Results' and displays a results table.
assertions.precondition: A pool is selected

assertions.description: The duel results table has columns: Candidate A, Candidate B, Winner, Confidence, Swapped, Date. Each row shows truncated IDs (8 chars), the winner highlighted, confidence as a decimal, position_swapped as Yes/No, and a formatted date.
assertions.precondition: Duel results have been loaded and at least one result exists

assertions.description: When a pool has no duel results, displays: 'No duel results for this pool.'
assertions.precondition: Duel results loaded but none exist

groups.name: Duel Pools — Copeland Ranking Correctness
groups.description: The Copeland ranking displayed in the candidates table must correctly reflect pairwise dominance. This validates the duel engine's ranking algorithm output as displayed on the page.

assertions.description: Candidates in the detail table are ranked by Copeland score in descending order. The # column shows 1-based rank. The candidate with the highest Copeland score is row #1.
assertions.precondition: A pool is selected with 2+ candidates

assertions.description: The Win Rate column shows alpha/(alpha+beta) formatted as a percentage. This must be consistent with the displayed Alpha and Beta values for each candidate.
assertions.precondition: A pool is selected with candidates showing alpha/beta values

assertions.description: If duel results are loaded, the number of wins for the top-ranked candidate (visible in the results table as winner_id matches) should be greater than or equal to wins for lower-ranked candidates. The Copeland ranking must be consistent with the displayed duel outcomes.
assertions.precondition: Pool selected with both candidates and duel results loaded

groups.name: Beam Runs — Layout & Empty State
groups.description: The BeamRunsTab has the same two-panel layout as DuelPoolsTab: fixed-width sidebar with runs list, flexible detail panel showing candidates grouped by generation.

assertions.description: The Beam Runs tab displays a header with text 'Beam Search Runs', a 'Refresh' button, and a run count indicator showing 'N runs'
assertions.precondition: Beam Runs tab is selected

assertions.description: When no beam runs exist, displays: 'No beam search runs yet. Beam search is triggered by the optimization pipeline to explore prompt variations.'
assertions.precondition: Beam Runs tab is selected and no runs exist

groups.name: Beam Runs — Run List & Candidates
groups.description: Run list shows status, agent_type, generation. Selecting a run loads candidates grouped by generation with expandable cards showing critique, changes, and prompt content.

assertions.description: Each beam run in the sidebar shows: a status badge (running=green, complete=blue, converged=cyan, failed=red), agent_type, generation count, truncated ID, optional pool_id link, and creation date
assertions.precondition: Beam Runs tab is selected and runs exist

assertions.description: After selecting a beam run, candidates are displayed grouped by generation number. Each group has a heading 'Generation N (M candidates)'. Groups are sorted by generation ascending (0 = seed, 1 = first children, etc.).
assertions.precondition: A beam run is selected with candidates

assertions.description: Clicking a beam candidate card expands it to show three sections: Critique (the LLM's critique of the parent prompt), Changes Summary (what was changed), and Prompt Content (the full rewritten prompt in a pre-formatted block). Clicking again collapses.
assertions.precondition: A beam run is selected with candidates

assertions.description: Beam candidates with a thinking_style display a purple badge (text-purple-400 bg-purple-900/30) showing the style name. Seed candidates (generation 0) may not have a thinking style.
assertions.precondition: Beam run selected with candidates that have thinking_style set

groups.name: Span Events — Filter Controls
groups.description: The SpanEventsTab has filter inputs for execution_id and agent_type, plus a Load button. Events are fetched on demand (not on mount).

assertions.description: The Span Events tab displays a header with text 'Span Events' and an event count indicator
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected

assertions.description: A text input with placeholder 'execution_id filter' (w-64) allows filtering span events by execution ID
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected

assertions.description: A text input with placeholder 'agent_type filter' (w-48) allows filtering span events by agent type
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected

assertions.description: Clicking the 'Load' button fetches span events from GET /meta-optimizer/span-events with the current filter values and displays them grouped by execution_id
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected

assertions.description: Before clicking Load, displays: 'No span events loaded. Enter optional filters and click Load.'
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected and Load has not been clicked

groups.name: Span Events — Event Display & Grouping
groups.description: Loaded events are grouped by execution_id with collapsible sections. Each group shows an event table with type-specific detail rendering.

assertions.description: Events are grouped by execution_id. Each group has a collapsible header showing the truncated execution ID (8 chars), event count, and agent type. Clicking the header toggles collapse ('+' when collapsed, '-' when expanded).
assertions.precondition: Span events have been loaded

assertions.description: Each execution group contains a table with columns: Step, Type, Agent, Details, Date. The Type column shows color-coded badges: reward=green, message=blue, object=purple.
assertions.precondition: Span events loaded and at least one group is expanded

assertions.description: Reward events display metric_name and reward_value. Values below 0.5 are shown in red (text-red-400), values >= 0.5 in green (text-green-400). This highlights underperforming agent steps.
assertions.precondition: Span events loaded with reward-type events visible

assertions.description: Message events show role (cyan) and content truncated to 200 characters. Clicking the content expands it to show the full text. Clicking again collapses to truncated form.
assertions.precondition: Span events loaded with message-type events where content > 200 chars

assertions.description: Object events show data_key (purple) and data_json truncated to 200 characters. Clicking expands to full JSON. This is used to inspect agent config snapshots and output data.
assertions.precondition: Span events loaded with object-type events where data_json > 200 chars

groups.name: Visual Design — Dark Theme Compliance
groups.description: All three new tabs follow the runner's dark zinc theme. Background colors, text colors, borders, and interactive states must be consistent with the existing meta-optimizer tabs.

assertions.description: The page content area uses a dark background. Panel containers use bg-zinc-900 with border-zinc-800 borders. Selected/active items use bg-zinc-800.
assertions.precondition: Any of the three new tabs is selected

assertions.description: Headings use text-zinc-200 (text-sm font-medium). Secondary text and labels use text-zinc-400 or text-zinc-500. Muted counts use text-xs text-zinc-500. All text is legible against the dark background.
assertions.precondition: Any of the three new tabs is selected

assertions.description: Status badges across all tabs use consistent color coding: active/running=green (text-green-400 bg-green-900/30), complete=blue, converged=cyan, failed=red, eliminated/pruned=zinc-500. The color conveys status at a glance.
assertions.precondition: Tab with data items showing status badges

assertions.description: All interactive elements (pool items, run items, candidate cards, table rows, expandable content) show hover feedback: hover:bg-zinc-800/50 or hover:bg-zinc-800/30 for rows. Cursor changes to pointer on hoverable elements.
assertions.precondition: Any of the three new tabs with data loaded

groups.name: API Integration & Data Flow
groups.description: All three tabs fetch data from the runner's HTTP API. API failures should not crash the UI.

assertions.description: The DuelPoolsTab automatically fetches from GET /meta-optimizer/duel-pools?limit=50 on mount. The Refresh button re-fetches the same endpoint.
assertions.precondition: Duel Pools tab is selected

assertions.description: The BeamRunsTab automatically fetches from GET /meta-optimizer/beam-runs?limit=50 on mount.
assertions.precondition: Beam Runs tab is selected

assertions.description: The SpanEventsTab does NOT auto-fetch on mount. Events are loaded only when the user clicks Load. This is intentional because span events can be voluminous and require filtering.
assertions.precondition: Span Events tab is selected

groups.name: Accessibility
groups.description: Interactive elements have proper ARIA roles, tabIndex, and keyboard event handlers for accessibility.

assertions.description: Pool list items, beam run items, and candidate cards have role='button', tabIndex={0}, and onKeyDown handlers supporting Enter/Space activation
assertions.precondition: Any tab with interactive list items

assertions.description: Expandable message and object content cells in SpanEventsTab have role='button' and tabIndex={0} for keyboard activation
assertions.precondition: Span events loaded with expandable content

states.name: Duel Pools Tab
states.description: Shows duel pool list, candidate rankings, and duel results

states.name: Beam Runs Tab
states.description: Shows beam search runs with candidates grouped by generation

states.name: Span Events Tab
states.description: Filterable span event viewer with execution grouping and expandable content
